nodes.evidence: commit(k) moves events from k.wal.stage to k.wal.store, incrementing clk and idx.
nodes.notes: Commit is the sole mechanism for promoting staged events to the canonical append-only history.

nodes.evidence: append(k, ...) appends e to k.wal.store directly.
nodes.notes: Append is the primary mutation path for immediate events.

nodes.evidence: stage() adds to stage; commit() moves stage to store; discard() clears stage. Store is the persistent history.
nodes.notes: Authority boundary between transient derivation (stage) and canonical truth (store).

nodes.evidence: lift iterates k.wal.store to create Temporal edges between consecutive events.
nodes.notes: Temporal causality is derived deterministically from the store order.

nodes.evidence: lift uses ht[e.wld] to create Causal edges within the same world.
nodes.notes: Causal edges link events within the same world context.

nodes.evidence: forall e in Graph.edges: e.typ == Causal -> g.nodes[e.src].wld == g.nodes[e.dst].wld
nodes.notes: Causal edges cannot cross world boundaries.

nodes.evidence: append increments clk and uses len(store) for idx, ensuring monotonicity.
nodes.notes: Append preserves the monotonic-clock invariant.

nodes.evidence: commit increments clk for each staged event before appending to store.
nodes.notes: Commit preserves the monotonic-clock invariant.

nodes.evidence: lift(k) returns a Graph derived deterministically from k.wal.store.
nodes.notes: Graph is a pure, deterministic projection of the WAL store.

nodes.evidence: DelegationGraph allows : CanonicalAuthority -> ExecutionAuthority -> Prop

nodes.evidence: THEOREM HISTORY.INDEX_HOMOMORPHISM.001: project(ctx, p, h) == p

nodes.evidence: executable : Forall(a : KernelAction(ctx), allowed_action(a) -> Executable(ctx, a))
